title: Make the repository typos-clean so the CI gate can cover all of it
description:
## What

quality-gates.yml runs typos over five crates by name (pkix-dane, pkix-dane-resolver, pkix-dnssec-anchor, pkix-aia-http, pkix-chain) rather than over the repository, because the repository is not typos-clean. There were 43 findings when last counted across the whole tree.

## Why it matters

The workflow carries a comment saying a gate permitted to fail is not a gate. A path list that has to be extended by hand every time a crate is cleaned is the kind of thing that silently stops tracking reality -- the same failure mode as the stale MSRV comment that prompted PKIX-z2g4 in the first place.

## Known cases

AGENTS.md line 103 has "non-clonable", which typos wants as "non-cloneable". That one is in normative text the maintainer wrote, inside non-negotiable #6, so it is a wording decision rather than a typo fix -- either accept the correction or add it to a typos allowlist with a note. A .typos.toml does not currently exist.

Several findings are likely in the same category: domain vocabulary typos does not know. The useful outcome is a short allowlist plus genuine fixes, not blanket suppression.

## Acceptance

[ ] typos passes over the whole repository
[ ] Domain vocabulary that typos misreads is in a committed .typos.toml with a comment, not suppressed inline case by case
[ ] The path list removed from quality-gates.yml so the gate covers everything
